Live SNKRDUNK per-card check completed 2026-09-08 21:00 JST via a real browser session on the paired device; market_index reconfirmed the same way (unchanged from the prior reading). Earlier on 2026-09-08 the buy-zone tiers for Umbreon ex SAR and Pikachu ex SAR were trimmed (~3-4%) after fresh Japanese-market research (an LDP trading-card regulation task force formed to target oripa/counterfeits/money-laundering, a PSA-backlog arbitrage squeeze, and pre-anniversary profit-taking) pointed to unresolved near-term sell pressure into the Sept 16 release; Pikachu VMAX CSR's tiers were left unchanged since its live floor firmed rather than fell. Gengar VMAX SA (SGG 020/019) was added 2026-09-08 following a requested evaluation: an out-of-print, deck-exclusive SAR whose PSA10 price has pulled back roughly a quarter from its August 2026 peak amid a broader market correction; its card art (sourced from Limitless TCG, since TCGdex does not catalogue this promo deck set) was added at 21:25 JST. The recurring hourly device-bound check continues to refresh prices automatically; tier levels are only revised on manual review or a scheduled add-card evaluation.
